settings.title: Drones at once
settings.description: How many drones Fleet runs at the same time. A job past this waits for one to finish.

settings.title: Checks at once
settings.description: How many of a step's checks run at the same time. Ships at half this machine's cores.

settings.title: Memory to keep free
settings.description: The share of memory Fleet leaves free before it starts another drone.

settings.title: Disk to keep free
settings.description: The disk space Fleet leaves free on the worktree volume before it starts another drone.

settings.title: First port
settings.description: Where the ports Fleet lends a job's servers start.

settings.title: Check time limit
settings.description: How long one check may run before Fleet stops it. A step's own limit wins over this.

settings.title: Judge time limit
settings.description: How long one Judge call may take before Fleet gives up on it.

settings.title: Command time limit
settings.description: How long Fleet works on one command from Bridge before it answers that it gave up.

settings.title: Reconnect interval
settings.description: How long Bridge waits before it looks for Fleet again after losing it.

settings.title: Keep run logs
settings.description: How long a finished job's logs stay on disk.

settings.title: Machine name
settings.description: How the other machines signed in to your account name this one. Blank uses the host's name.

settings.title: Sign-in app
settings.description: The client id of the OAuth app Armada signs in with. Blank leaves sign-in unavailable until an app is registered.

settings.title: Store address
settings.description: The address of the central store your machines share. Blank leaves sign-in unavailable until a store is deployed.

settings.title: Agent
settings.description: The program each drone runs.

settings.title: Agent program
settings.description: The agent's program, by name on PATH or by absolute path.

settings.title: Drone PATH
settings.description: The directories a drone's PATH holds, in order.

settings.title: Models
settings.description: The models a job or a step may choose from.

settings.title: Default model
settings.description: The model a step runs on when nothing names one.

settings.title: Job model
settings.description: The model a Job starts on when nothing names one.

settings.title: Job proposer model
settings.description: The model that reads a request and proposes a job.

settings.title: Default effort
settings.description: The effort a step runs at when it names none. Harness default passes nothing.

settings.title: Judge effort
settings.description: The effort each Judge call runs at.

settings.title: Offer a lower default at
settings.description: How much of the weekly plan window must be used before the default model is offered a step down until the window resets.

settings.title: Lower default model
settings.description: The model the default steps down to when you accept the offer.

settings.title: Drone baseline
settings.description: What every drone is told before its step's own brief.
settings.default:
You are working one step of a job in a git worktree Fleet made for it.
Stay inside the worktree. Run the checks the step names before you hand in evidence.
When the step is done, submit evidence that says what changed and how you know it works.
settings.value:
You are working one step of a job in a git worktree Fleet made for it.
Stay inside the worktree. Run the checks the step names before you hand in evidence.
When the step is done, submit evidence that says what changed and how you know it works.

settings.title: Job proposer
settings.description: What the job proposer is told before the request.
settings.default:
Read the request and propose a job: which workflow it takes, what to call it, and,
where the work is several jobs, the order between them.
settings.value:
Read the request and propose a job: which workflow it takes, what to call it, and,
where the work is several jobs, the order between them.

settings.title: Workflows for Jobs
settings.description: A Job follows a workflow's steps. Off, every Job is a plain Job.

settings.title: Workflows switched off
settings.description: Workflows a Job is not offered and cannot be given, on this machine or in one repository.

settings.title: Jobs on your words can act
settings.description: A Job started on your words may redirect a job itself. Off, it reads one and suggests it.

settings.title: Dispute reviews
settings.description: A job that disputes a Fleet notice starts a review job in Armada, and Fleet reads replies for pushback. Off, the dispute is kept and nothing starts.

settings.title: Draft pull requests
settings.description: A pull request is opened as a draft unless the repository, the workflow or the job says otherwise.

settings.title: Open guides the first time
settings.description: A guide opens once for a piece you have not met.

settings.title: Interface sounds
settings.description: A quiet tick when you move through a list or press a control.

settings.title: Reduce motion
settings.description: Stops Armada's animations. Nothing else on this Mac changes.

settings.title: Open pull request links
settings.description: A link that starts armada://pull opens Bridge on that pull request's review. Off, Armada does not claim the link from macOS and ignores one it is handed.

settings.title: Notifications
settings.description: A macOS notification when a job needs you and Bridge is not in front.

settings.title: Folders jobs reach
settings.description: Folders outside its slots a job may read and write with no card, and folders it may not.

settings.title: Editor command
settings.description: The editor Bridge opens a file in. {file} and {line} are filled in. Empty uses $VISUAL, then $EDITOR, then this Mac's default.

settings.title: Terminal
settings.description: The terminal Bridge opens a worktree in.

settings.title: Custom terminal command
settings.description: Run when Terminal is Custom. {dir} is filled in with the worktree.

settings.title: Open pull requests in
settings.description: Where every pull request link in Bridge opens.

settings.title: Spacing
settings.description: Room around rows, panels and controls.

settings.title: Thread look
settings.description: The Aa panel and Settings, Thread write this.

settings.title: Row view
settings.description: The Cockpit row menu's View group writes this.

settings.title: Layout
settings.description: Settings → Layout writes this.
